<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 224.1201 (likely [M+H]⁺), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈223.1128 Da. The formula that best matches this mass and the observed ~17 % M+1 intensity (≈15 C atoms) is C₁₂H₁₅O₄. No other hetero‑atoms are indicated, so the formula is simply C12H15O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H15O4</final_answer>
